text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-The opposition says the ruling Kenya African National Union (KANU) party is taking advantage of its position in power to obtain funding from state coffers.
- Parliament unanimously passed a motion seeking to do away with government interference in the running of co-operatives and give co-operative members more say in decision-making.

- The government defuses a month-long dispute between Tanzanian and Kenyan farmers by erecting beacons pending proper border marking, to solve confusion over a one kilometre stretch of the common border.

- Stockbroking firm Shah, Munge & Partners say a new investment fund sponsored by United Kingdom-based Regent Management Fund Limited is to be lauched shortly and is expected to be listed on the Nairobi Stock Exchange.
